title: Staged KNN API: KnnGraph + optional fit_transform input
description:
## Why
Consumers should separate steps: run KNN once, pass &KnnGraph into PaCMAP (and later other algorithms) as optional input.

## What
- Public KnnGraph (NeighborList + n/k/metric metadata)
- compute_knn returns KnnGraph (step 1)
- fit_transform(..., knn: Option<&KnnGraph>, ...) skips search when Some (step 2)
- Validate n/k/metric; k >= n_neighbors+50 for PaCMAP mid-near window
- Unit tests: None≡internal; Some skips search; reject bad graphs; multi-config reuse
design: Do not extract flow-knn yet; keep type in flow-pacmap::knn shaped for future consumers.
acceptance_criteria: Public staged API compiles; unit tests cover None/Some/validation/reuse
close_reason: Staged KnnGraph API: compute_knn returns KnnGraph; fit_transform takes Option<&KnnGraph>; validation + unit tests pass (cargo check/test -p flow-pacmap).

title: Follow-up: GPU kNN via cubecl/ann-search (not OxiCUDA PTX)
description: Feature-gate like tru-ols/peacoqc. Resolve cubecl 0.9 vs manifolds 0.10 first. Still emit KnnGraph for staged downstream APIs.
notes:
Investigation (2026-07-24):

Benefit verdict for PaCMAP / FCS workloads:
- Full PaCMAP on GPU: no peer has it (manifolds GPU is UMAP/t-SNE only; oxicuda PTX has no pacmap kernel).
- KNN stage (~8–12% of 50k e2e): possible via ann-search-rs feature `gpu` (cubecl 0.10): exhaustive, IVF, NN-Descent, CAGRA — NOT HNSW. CPU HNSW already ~0.5s@50k / ~13.5s@500k; GPU worth A/B mainly for larger n or when exact is chosen.
- Optimize/Adam (~88–92% of 50k e2e): highest leverage, but no off-the-shelf kernels — custom work.
- PCA init / pair build: low ROI vs optimize.
- Blocker: workspace cubecl 0.9 (peacoqc/tru-ols) vs ann-search-rs/manifolds cubecl 0.10.
- Prefer cubecl/wgpu path over oxicuda PTX (NVIDIA-only; knn_topk exists but PaCMAP e2e still CPU).
2026-07-24: Highest-impact GPU path (Adam+pair gradients) landed as flow-crates-rep.9.1 / OptimizeBackend::Gpu with cubecl 0.9 wgpu. Remaining .9 scope is optional GPU kNN via ann-search (blocked on cubecl 0.10).
